text: DSH Voice Talk 为 DSH Web 增加语音对话：点击输入框旁的麦克风进入通话，识别说话内容并在停顿后提交，也可把助手回复逐段朗读。它通过 Web 客户端会话输入和宿主语音桥接工作，提供连续语音输入、播报、静音、停止朗读、音色切换及语速设置。适合希望免键盘操作或听取回复的 DSH Web 用户；系统语音可直接使用，云端语音需配置对应服务。

DSH Voice Talk adds voice chat to DSH Web. Tap the composer microphone to speak; recognized speech is submitted after a pause, and assistant replies are read aloud. It offers mute, playback, voice selection, and rate controls. System speech works directly; cloud voices need setup.
想用说话的方式给 DSH 输入问题
能不能让 DSH 把回答念出来？
我希望在浏览器里开启免手操作的语音对话
让 DSH 听我说完后自动提交这句话
I want to talk to DSH instead of typing prompts.
Can DSH read its replies aloud while they stream?
I need a hands-free voice conversation in the web interface.
「语音输入」：点击输入框旁的麦克风进入通话，识别出的语句显示在会话中并在停顿后自动提交。
「回复朗读」：助手回复的正文会在生成过程中分段送入语音合成并播放；代码块等 Markdown 表面标记会从朗读文本中清理。
「通话控制」：通话界面可静音麦克风、停止当前播报或挂断；按 Esc 也能退出通话。
「音色与语速」：设置和通话界面可以选择系统、千问或讯飞语音，并调整说话人和播报速度。
「云端语音识别」：通过宿主侧 WebSocket 桥接使用千问或讯飞识别服务；识别器可设置语言、模型和服务地址。
DSH Voice Talk 使用云端千问或讯飞识别/合成时，会将语音或文本交给所选服务处理；宿主桥接从 DSH 凭据存储读取对应凭据，系统语音选项可本地使用。
我想边做事边听 DSH 读出回答

dsh-voice-talk README · dsh-voice-talk：DSH Web 的语音对话模式：点一下麦克风进入全屏通话，边说边听，AI 回复边生成边朗读。界面中英双语，适配明暗主题，支持语速调节与音色切换。

中文 | [English](README.en.md)

[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-voice-talk)
[](./LICENSE)

dsh-voice-talk README · 1. 安装：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-voice-talk
dsh web   # 装完重启
```

源码安装：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/duoduoqian708/dsh-voice-talk.git
cd dsh-voice-talk && npm install && npm run build
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-voice-talk
```

需要 dsh 的 web profile：0.1.0-rc.7+（0.1.0-rc.x 与 0.1.5-rc.x 两代宿主线均已适配）；另需 Chrome / Edge、麦克风权限与网络。

dsh-voice-talk README · 2. 配置语音：发音默认用系统语音，免费；音色和语速都能调，挑一个顺耳的、把语速调好，效果就很不错。想要更自然的音色，可以切到千问（按量计费，约 1 元 / 万字符）。

语音识别需要云端引擎：在[阿里云百炼申请一个 API Key](https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/cn-beijing/model/settings/api-key)，然后到 设置 → 插件 → 语音对话，填进千问的「设置」即可；模型和地址已内置，充值就能用。
dsh-voice-talk README · 3. 开始使用：在对话页或工作台的输入框旁，有一个麦克风图标；点它进入全屏通话层，直接说话即可。红色挂机键或 `Esc` 退出；通话中可以静音、收起。

dsh-voice-talk README · 配置项：设置页里改的是持久默认，通话层上调的只对本次通话有效。

| 配置 | 说明 | 默认 |
|---|---|---|
| 说话打断播报 | 说话时打断正在播报的内容，建议戴耳机 | 关 |
| 停顿多久自动发送（秒） | 说完停顿多久自动提交 | 2 |
| 声纹效果 | 通话层波形样式：律动 / 波纹 | 波纹 |
| 语速 | 播报语速，按引擎设默认，通话层可临时调 | 1.0x |

dsh-voice-talk README · 产品特色：- 跟随系统主题：浅色 / 深色自动适配。
- 中英文双语：跟随平台语言设置，界面完整本地化。
- 密钥只存本机、绝不上传：浏览器接触不到密钥，语音请求由宿主代理转发。
- 开源 MIT：代码可审计、可自建。
dsh-voice-talk README · 彩蛋：假设你不想盯着屏幕，想到户外活动一下；假设你恰好开了代理端口——那就带着手机出门，边散步边聊开发吧。

dsh-voice-talk README · 问题反馈：遇到问题或有想法，欢迎通过任一方式反馈：

- 提交 [Issue](https://github.com/duoduoqian708/dsh-voice-talk/issues)（推荐，便于跟进与修复）
- 在插件市场的卡片下留言（与插件主页的讨论区互通）

dsh-voice-talk README · dsh-voice-talk：Voice chat mode for DSH Web: tap the mic to enter a full-screen call, speak and listen as you go, and replies are read aloud as they stream. Bilingual UI, light/dark theme aware, with speech-rate and voice controls.

English | [中文](README.md)

[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-voice-talk)
[](./LICENSE)

dsh-voice-talk README · 1. Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-voice-talk
dsh web   # restart after install
```

Install from source:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/duoduoqian708/dsh-voice-talk.git
cd dsh-voice-talk && npm install && npm run build
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-voice-talk
```

Requires the dsh web profile: 0.1.0-rc.7+ (both the 0.1.0-rc.x and 0.1.5-rc.x host lines are supported); Chrome / Edge, microphone permission and a network connection are also needed.

dsh-voice-talk README · 2. Configure voice：Speech playback defaults to the system voice, free of charge: voice and rate are both adjustable — pick a voice that suits you and tune the rate, and it sounds great. For a more natural timbre, switch to Qwen (usage-based, ≈¥1 per 10k chars).

dsh-voice-talk README · 2. Configure voice：Speech recognition needs a cloud engine: get an API Key from [Alibaba Cloud Model Studio](https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/cn-beijing/model/settings/api-key), then paste it into Qwen's "Settings" under Settings → Plugins → Voice chat; the model and endpoint are built in.

dsh-voice-talk README · 3. Start talking：There is a mic icon next to the input box on the conversation page or workspace; tap it to enter the full-screen call and just start speaking. The red hang-up button or `Esc` exits; you can mute or collapse the panel mid-call.

dsh-voice-talk README · Settings：Changes on the settings page are persistent defaults; changes made in the call overlay apply to the current call only.

| Setting | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| Barge-in while speaking | Interrupt the readout by speaking; headphones recommended | Off |
| Auto-send after a pause (s) | How long a pause submits the utterance | 2 |
| Voice wave | Call-overlay waveform style: equalizer / ripple | Ripple |
| Rate | Readout speed, default per engine, adjustable per session | 1.0x |

dsh-voice-talk README · Highlights：- Follows the system theme: light / dark out of the box.
- Bilingual UI (Chinese / English): follows the platform language setting.
- Keys stay on your machine and are never uploaded: the browser never sees them, and speech requests are proxied by the host.
- Open source under MIT: auditable and self-hostable.

dsh-voice-talk README · Easter egg：Suppose you would rather not stare at a screen and feel like getting outdoors; suppose you happen to have a proxy port open — then take your phone out for a walk and talk through your development while strolling.

dsh-voice-talk README · Feedback：Found a bug or have an idea? Reach us either way:

- Open a [GitHub issue](https://github.com/duoduoqian708/dsh-voice-talk/issues) (preferred, easiest to track and fix)
- Comment on the plugin's card in the marketplace (shared with the plugin's discussion thread)
